details.description: The Pillsbury Chakki Fresh Atta is made of locally sourced high-quality whole wheat. It makes your rotis healthy and soft for up to 6 hours. Pillsbury uses a special traditional chakki grinding method that locks in the nutrients in the flour, ensuring easy digestion for you and your family.
